headline: Coalition spokesman Al-Maliki claims 9 drones intercepted over Riyadh/Medina/Eastern Province on Thursday
dek: Coalition forces intercepted and destroyed four drones over Riyadh and Medina regions plus another over Riyadh in separate incidents, and earlier destroyed four drones launched toward the Eastern Province — nine claimed intercepts in one day. No casualties or damage reported by the coalition.
sources: Coalition spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, X posts
fault_line: Same as 0800-01: Riyadh safe (intercepts) vs defenses failing (Ansar Allah 'direct hit' claims, prior Riyadh airport deaths).
